# gtm_v1_move_entities_to_folder (Action)

Moves entities to a GTM Folder.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The GTM Account ID.
- `container_id` (String) The GTM Container ID.
- `folder_id` (String) The GTM Folder ID.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `fingerprint` (String) The fingerprint of the GTM Folder as computed at storage time. This value is recomputed whenever the folder is modified.
- `name` (String) Folder display name.
- `request_json` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Complete JSON request body. Typed request attributes override fields with the same JSON name.
- `tag_id` (List of String) The tags to be moved to the folder.
- `trigger_id` (List of String) The triggers to be moved to the folder.
- `variable_id` (List of String) The variables to be moved to the folder.
